dmp.description:
Until recently, science has paid attention to the sustainable and circular economy from the side of environmental and natural sciences, less from the point of view of economics, and business process management.  Although sustainability and circular economy processes must be viewed in a holistic way, as the business environment, as well as the ability of companies to improve resource efficiency, become a significant component for the implementation of Circular Economy. It is becoming increasingly obvious that the European Green Deal has a significant impact on the development strategies of companies and is becoming a significant component of ensuring sustainability. The shift from business-as-usual to circular business, from something trendy is becoming mainstream for the economy. The Quintuple helix concept will be used to justify the circular business model for industrial
symbiosis and to raise the awareness and competences of society and the business environment regarding circular economy, resource efficiency and industrial symbiosis (fostering cross-sectoral cooperation).
